items.claim: CEO 表示 Arm 開始以晶片形式直接供貨，進入新業務
items.quote: Arm, and we are supplying CPUs as chips.
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 稱做自家晶片的首要原因是夥伴提出需求
items.quote: reason 0 is our partners have asked us for it.
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 給出 CSS 占權利金比重的口徑
items.quote: represents almost 20% of our royalties and growing.
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 估算 agentic AI 下每 GW 所需 CPU 核心數增為 4 倍
items.quote: 120 million CPU cores for that same gigawatt
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 承認 AI 投資可能放緩、估值可能變動，但主張 AI 不會消失
items.quote: it may be a financial bubble in the case of investment
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: 產品主管說明 AGI CPU 已可供貨
items.quote: Arm AGI CPU is available now, and we're so proud of that.
items.speaker: Mohamed Awad

items.claim: 客戶正在評估 AGI CPU
items.quote: Customers are actually evaluating it as we speak.
items.speaker: Mohamed Awad

items.claim: 管理層給出 AGI CPU 量產時點
items.quote: by the end of the year, and we are excited to share
items.speaker: Mohamed Awad

items.claim: AGI CPU 規格：Neoverse V3 核心數
items.quote: We pack in 136 of those cores
items.speaker: Mohamed Awad

items.claim: 管理層給出已出貨至資料中心的 Neoverse 核心累計數
items.quote: over 1.25 billion Arm Neoverse cores
items.speaker: Mohamed Awad

items.claim: 管理層指稱 x86 業者需過度配置資料中心
items.quote: data center operators have to overprovision
items.speaker: Mohamed Awad

items.claim: CEO 與 x86 同等結構比較的效能主張
items.quote: 36 kilowatts, 2x the performance in the same power.
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 量化每 GW 額外電力對應的資本支出
items.quote: it's up to $10 billion of
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 承諾 AGI CPU 後續世代產品線
items.quote: So we are committing to future generations of this product.
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: Meta 方面稱為多世代合作
items.quote: multigenerational partnership. I just want to emphasize
items.speaker: Santosh Janardhan

items.claim: Meta 說明首顆合作 CPU 的設計取向
items.quote: something to minimize risk for this iteration.
items.speaker: Santosh Janardhan

items.claim: CEO 列出已承諾購買 AGI CPU 的客戶
items.quote: we have committed customers, Meta, OpenAI, Cloudflare, SAP
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 給出 AI 資料中心權利金 TAM 現況口徑
items.quote: that represents today about a $3 billion TAM.
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 稱雲端 AI 業務數年內將成最大業務
items.quote: probably be our largest business in a few years.
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 給出晶片業務未來 TAM 估計
items.quote: we think this represents about $100 billion TAM for us
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 給出 2030 年前整體可觸及 TAM
items.quote: greater than a $1 trillion TAM by the end of the decade.
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 稱 IP／CSS 業務表現優於 IPO 路演時對投資人所說
items.quote: we're actually ahead of that.
items.speaker: Rene Haas

items.claim: CEO 重申 Arm 現在提供三種型態：IP、CSS、晶片
items.quote: IP, CSS and chips. IP, CSS and chips.
items.speaker: Rene Haas
